methodologicalChange: The previous router check did not have user-confirmation continuation and did not return canonical external URL payloads. The regression simulates confirmation ONLY after the initial question resolves to its exact historical source. Therefore before/after routing success counts are not strictly like-for-like independent accuracy estimates; compare rather as engineering acceptance progress.
codeChanges: Bilingual two-facet documentary intent gate using original source subject and action categories, not raw evaluation utterance strings.
Explicitly confirmed historical context may continue to same source when the follow-up has an appropriate source-specific cue.
Generic lexical hits to historical topics fail closed unless a two-facet source match or an exact catalog-authored variant.
Priest meditation requires interior/mental-prayer scope, not merely an incidental mention of priest plus lay private prayer.
Original source navigation gives actual HTTPS URL plus narrow section locator and witness classification; no generic Catechism fallback if the pointer registry is absent.
Cross-character handoff rejects changed documentary URLs, requires explicit acceptance and confirmation.
The hybrid router honors authoritative historical-source gates and source gaps, without adding generated answer content.
remaining: These 48 cases were editor-authored, repeatedly inspected and thus NOT a fresh or representative holdout.
Neither 25 nor 26 correct source routes means a certified answer: human doctrinal and documentary-voice reviews remain undone.
Unknown compound queries, novel expressions and French visitor utterances require new blind evaluation.
The bridge still needs a consumer UI and exact source-opening workflow; validated URLs are returned but no user-facing avatar change was made.
